rules.decision: Employment Pass (EP) minimum qualifying monthly salary threshold
rules.description: Candidates must earn at least SGD 5,600 per month (increasing progressively up to SGD 10,700 for older candidates) to qualify for an Employment Pass.
Employment Pass applications must score at least 40 points on the Complementarity Assessment Framework (COMPASS) to pass the points criteria.

rules.decision: Non-resident employment income tax exemption (60-day short-term mobility rule)
rules.rate_for_61_to_182_days: 15% flat or progressive resident rates, whichever yields higher tax
rules.description: Non-residents exercising employment in Singapore for 60 days or less in a calendar year are exempt from tax. Stays between 61 and 182 days are subject to non-resident taxation.
